decision: A moment detector proposes the clip; people build the campaign
why: Detection is pattern work a model does well; brand and timing judgment stay human.
value: Campaigns start minutes after a moment, with a person accountable.

decision: Posts are slots dragged across time-zone lanes, with local peaks shaded
why: The scheduling problem is spatial: same moment, three local evenings.
alternative: A form with date-time pickers per market.
value: Off-peak slots are obvious and fixed by dragging, or by arrow keys.

decision: Projected reach is fit-weighted and recomputed as pages are selected
why: Follower counts overstate reach; audience fit predicts view-through.
value: Honest projections that respond to every choice.

decision: The posting feed arrives over a Broadcast channel
why: Team members in three time zones watch the same launch.
value: Everyone sees the same live state without polling.
